scope: Email send diagnostics, Alt+S sending review, and selectable HTML or plain-text message reading. This is a beta testing build.

topics.title: HTML and plain-text email reading
details: Options, Email, Email format offers HTML and plain text. HTML is the default, including for existing installations without a saved format choice. Say email format HTML or email format plain text to change it.

HTML message reading preserves safe clickable links, headings, bold, italic, underline, numbered lists and bullet points. Tab and Shift+Tab move among links, and Enter opens the focused link. Say list links and open link followed by its number. Normal arrow reading and Escape remain available. HTML is rendered passively: scripts and remote images are not loaded. This is basic email formatting, not a full browser layout.
Plain text uses the original plain-text MIME part when available, otherwise the readable HTML text. Changing the format of an open message returns its reading position to the beginning.

topics.title: Alt+S send shortcut
details: Alt+S and Ctrl+Enter start the same review as send it. They commit the current editable header before reviewing. A yes confirmation is still required before sending.

topics.title: Keyboard update and email send confirmations
details: Update installation and email send review prompts support Y or N immediately, arrows or Tab/Shift+Tab to change the spoken Yes/No choice, Enter to activate it, and Escape to cancel. Confirmation keys take priority over any text remaining in an email header field. Voice yes and no still work.

topics.title: Specific sending errors and safe retries
details: The draft remains saved, but the spoken error now explains invalid recipient data, expired sign-in, missing sending permission, or provider rejection instead of hiding the reason. Account renewal failures before submission do not count as an attempted send. Explicit provider rejection releases the attempted-send block so the corrected draft can be reviewed again.

Timeouts, network failures during submission, unclear acceptance and provider server errors remain protected against duplicate sends. Check Sent Mail before trying again. No automatic retry or real test email is sent by these checks. Actual sending with the affected account still needs testing on the user’s computer.

topics.title: Cleaner message spacing
details: Plain-text messages normalize Windows line endings and collapse repeated empty lines to one blank line. HTML source indentation and nested layout containers do not create extra reading lines. Consecutive HTML breaks retain at most one blank line. An intentional blank line is still spoken as Blank line by keyboard reading.

Automated checks cover MIME selection, safe links, lists, formatting, blank-line cleanup, default/voice format selection, send review shortcuts, last-field commits, expired sign-in and rejected permission responses. Windows checks exercise Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter link activation and Alt+S.
